name: Can a walk-in shower help increase resale value in Los Angeles homes?

mainEntity.name: Does replacing a bathtub with a walk-in shower usually help or hurt resale value in Los Angeles neighborhoods?
mainEntity.text: Does replacing a bathtub with a walk-in shower usually help or hurt resale value in Los Angeles neighborhoods?

acceptedAnswer.text: A walk-in shower can add resale appeal when it feels well designed, modern, and appropriate for the home. In many Los Angeles neighborhoods, buyers like updated primary bathrooms with spacious showers, especially when the design looks clean and luxurious. However, removing the only bathtub can reduce flexibility for some buyers, particularly in family-oriented homes or smaller properties where a tub is still expected in at least one bathroom. The best resale strategy is usually to match the remodel to the home’s layout and target market rather than following a trend blindly. A high-quality walk-in shower with strong waterproofing, good lighting, and attractive finishes often helps the bathroom feel more valuable. The overall impact depends on whether the home still offers a tub elsewhere and how the rest of the property is positioned in the market.
